entries.title: Boids Flocking Around a Moving Obstacle Drone
entries.description: A swarm of small colored spheres uses flocking rules to follow a leader drone box that slowly weaves through space, avoiding and flowing around a larger transparent moving obstacle block, leaving faint motion trails and showing velocity vectors as arrows.
entries.seed: Boids Flocking Around a Moving Obstacle Drone: A swarm of small colored spheres uses flocking rules to follow a leader drone box that slowly weaves through space, avoiding and flowing around a larger transparent moving obstacle block, leaving faint motion trails and showing velocity vectors as arrows.

entries.title: Predator–Prey Bird Flocks in a Sky Corridor
entries.description: Multiple flocks of bird-like arrows glide through a long, light-blue 3D corridor while a few larger red “hawk” cones chase them, causing the smaller flock members to split, re-merge, and occasionally collide with invisible boundaries that bounce them back.

entries.title: School of Fish Swarming Around a Coral Pillar
entries.description: Dozens of small blue ellipsoids (fish) flock and swirl around a stationary, branching coral cylinder, occasionally tightening into dense balls when a larger predator fish sweeps through, with each fish leaving a short, fading trail in clear “water.”

entries.title: Drone Swarm Mapping a 3D Building Interior
entries.description: A swarm of small cube drones with glowing tips spreads through the interior of a semi-transparent building shell, coordinating to scan different rooms, avoid collisions, attach to walls to “scan,” then detach and regroup, while a 3D minimap meter tracks coverage.
